name: DC Hub
summary: Orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence: start with execute_plan. It publishes the Data Center Power Index (DCPI), a daily score of where data centers can get grid power across 300+ markets.
description: DC Hub is the orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence: start with execute_plan. It also publishes the Data Center Power Index (DCPI), a daily score of where data centers can get grid power across 300+ markets. Agents can query it and cite it.

It also covers mapped power, grid, gas and fiber assets and carries live grid feeds from the seven US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), plus retail and wholesale electricity prices by state and ISO. Answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line.
It is a hosted remote server over streamable HTTP at https://dchub.cloud/mcp (96 tools). DCHUB_API_KEY is optional. It is a community listing, not made or endorsed by Anthropic.
notice: Every tool call, including its parameters, the session id and the API key if one is sent, is logged by DC Hub for rate limits, billing and quality. See the README's privacy notes before querying sites you are evaluating.

guide.title: Set up
paragraphs: Add it to Claude Code as a remote HTTP server: run claude mcp add with the http transport, the name dchub and the endpoint https://dchub.cloud/mcp, which loads all 96 tools. DCHUB_API_KEY is optional. The repository README has the same setup for other clients.

guide.title: Download the source
paragraphs: The repository holds the server source, its manifests and the tool list.
